parent_objective: design explicit current-sim scenario task-family generation before any rollout/training
supersedes: scenario generation without explicit metadata schema

public_gates: M2276 must define explicit role families target support counts and metadata schema
M2276 must freeze obstacle timing lateral-offset recovery-window and hidden-dynamics role instrumentation
M2276 must choose a config/materialization route without running rollout or training
M2276 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs explicit scenario family generation after support audit gaps
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rollout ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if design omits any high-severity M2274 gap
stop if design admits training before config/materialization audit
stop if design uses actor-forbidden labels as deployable inputs
fallback_plan: route to config materialization if design is complete
route to metadata schema repair if instrumentation is incomplete
route to synthesis if role targets cannot be made explicit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2275 admits scenario task-family generation design

training_stage.stage_objective: design scenario task-family generation and metadata instrumentation
admission_evidence: M2274 primary metrics are present but role and direct scenario axes are incomplete
allowed_updates: M2276 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by design
next_stage_criteria: materialization outputs and acceptance criteria are frozen

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2276 designs scenario metadata and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2276; no wrong-history reset-hidden or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Scenario generation labels are for task construction/evaluation only and must not enter actor input.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns support gaps into a new scenario-generation branch
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit config materialization for a role-supported benchmark pack
must_synthesize_if: M2276 would route directly to training

hypothesis: Explicit role-family generation and metadata instrumentation can close the task-quality support gaps found by M2274.
success_criteria: materialization artifacts and acceptance gates are defined
a non-ranking materialization route is selected
failure_criteria: M2276 starts new training reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2276 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2276 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual scenario task-family generation design artifact

decision_rule: M2276 passes if it freezes role-family generation, metadata schema, materialization outputs, and a non-ranking next route.
